# RAGbase Shield company forms and company words (English). Written for RAGbase Shield, Apache-2.0.
# Matching is case and accent insensitive. Sections (read by ragbase_shield.engine.locale, bundle("en")):
#   [forms]   legal forms written after a company name ("Northvale Analytics, Inc."). The form stays in clear,
#             the words before it are the company. One entry per line: "form<TAB>strong|weak". A strong form
#             makes a company of one capitalised word before it; a weak form needs two words or a trigger.
#             A spelled-out form (with spaces) is never a name word and never starts a company name.
#   [suffix]  words that end a company name ("Brightwater Capital Partners"): the capitalised words before
#             one of these form a company together with it, no legal form needed
#   [generic] generic company words: never the distinctive part of a company name on their own, accepted
#             inside a longer name ("Lakeshore Medical Center")
#   [trigger] lower-case words right before a company name: "at X", "joined X", "client X"

# [forms]
inc	strong
inc.	strong
incorporated	strong
llc	strong
l.l.c.	strong
llp	strong
l.l.p.	strong
lllp	strong
lp	weak
l.p.	strong
ltd	strong
ltd.	strong
limited	strong
plc	strong
p.l.c.	strong
pllc	strong
p.c.	strong
pc	weak
corp	strong
